# VRS RealInvest

## Business Summary
VRS RealInvest is an Australian buyer's agency and real estate coaching business. We represent buyers and help busy professionals build wealth through strategic Australian real estate investing, providing end-to-end guidance from strategy to settlement.

## Details
- **Company Name**: VRS RealInvest Pty Ltd
- **Services**: 
  - Buyer's Agent services
  - Real estate investment coaching & strategy sessions
  - Suburb & property research using data and fundamentals
  - Negotiation & contract review support
- **Service Locations**: Australia-wide (focusing on low-risk suburbs with owner-occupier demand)
- **Founder**: Sudhesh K Valappil
- **Website**: https://vrsrealinvest.com.au

- **Governing Jurisdiction**: New South Wales (NSW), Australia
